prompts.desktop:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity image mockup of the SECOND SECTION of Órbita marketing agency homepage, not the hero. This is a materially new visual direction after rejecting a big industrial valve ad pasted above a WhatsApp chat. Follow the approved business offer: human agency creates and manages advertising for ecommerce and B2B; GISBA supports information and agency-client coordination. No bot in this section. No standalone software sale. No fabricated outcomes, prices, testimonials or integrations.
Visual approach: sophisticated editorial service explanation, precision and restrained task-specific visual demos inspired by Linear's clarity and Superside's creative work presentation, not copying their assets. Three connected but visually distinct scenes, generous useful spacing, front-facing flat compositions. No generic stock office photo, no decorative planets, no full dashboard, no WhatsApp interface, no valves, no packaging ad, no repeated giant numbered cards, no long arrow diagram. Use Órbita colors ivory #f6f3eb, ink #0b0d0b, olive #48622e, dark panels #171d17, lime #c7f45b for accent and CTA. Typography Manrope bold and DM Sans, sharp legible Spanish.
Top copy EXACT: eyebrow "EL TRABAJO DE ÓRBITA"; headline "Así trabajamos tu publicidad."; supporting line "Creamos los anuncios, gestionamos las campañas y revisamos contigo qué ajustar."
Three scenes:
1 Heading "Creamos tus anuncios". A beautiful compact creative work board: two frontal complementary ad treatments for an illustrative terracotta outdoor backpack product, quality product photography on muted ivory with olive typography "Hecha para tu día." and a small companion cropped detail, restrained editorial annotations, not a social app feed. This visual demonstrates crafting advertising. Caption EXACT "Mensaje y diseño para tu negocio."
2 Heading "Gestionamos tus campañas". A crisp minimal illustrative campaign review worksheet, not GISBA UI or a dashboard. A small thumbnail of the SAME backpack ad beside an editorial magnified adjustment note "Revisar mensaje y destino"; unobtrusive three channel labels "Google · Meta · TikTok" and small label "Según alcance". Show human review through a margin pencil annotation and selected text region, no graphs, numeric performance, status claims or futuristic machinery. Caption EXACT "Revisamos la ejecución y qué ajustar."
3 Heading "Revisamos contigo". An elegant frontal short proposal document, title "Próximo paso", with one legible statement "Te explicamos qué proponemos ajustar." and two simple editorial annotations "Órbita propone" / "Tú aportas contexto", no fake chat, no fabricated approvals or software functionality. A subtle document tab "Coordinación con GISBA" places software in supporting role, not central product. Caption EXACT "Sabes qué hicimos y qué sigue."
Bottom: one dominant lime button EXACT "Agenda una reunión". One quiet readable label "Ejemplos ilustrativos · Recreación generada". Essential copy in large readable type. No commercial conditions footer, no extra buttons, no navigation. The reader should see actual examples of work, not a diagram made of icons or mostly text. No browser chrome, no watermarks. Desktop composition: width1440 equivalent, landscape whole section approximately1440x950. Headline at upper left, support under it. Three aligned open editorial columns across middle with heading ABOVE each distinct visual and caption BELOW; no outer card containers. First visual photography, second fine paper review worksheet, third warm pale document with restrained olive annotation. Visuals substantial, clean alignment, hierarchy. CTA below scenes, centered or left aligned. Keep all section content visible with margins. Deliver one desktop image only.
